turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Good morning, it's Anna from the plant. You asked for a quote on the shelving uprights.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, we are opening a second warehouse in November and need about four hundred uprights.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Who signs off on the order for the new warehouse, you or the owner? And by when does the racking have to be standing?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I sign up to two million, above that it's the owner. The racking has to be up by the twentieth of November.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Then the drawings need to be approved by mid-October. Can we go through them on Wednesday at eleven?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wednesday at eleven works, I'll bring our warehouse manager.

turns.speaker: rep
turns.text: Good. The price stays as in the September quote.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Fine. We stopped buying from the other supplier two years ago, their uprights bent, so we are staying with you.
